newsitem.title: FRANCE: C'LUX plans Buenos Aires service for Sept.
newsitem.headline: C'LUX plans Buenos Aires service for Sept.

text.p: Cargolux Airlines International said it planned to launch a full-freighter service to Buenos Aires from Luxembourg in September 1997.

"Demand is currently booming in Latin America for European exports giving the opportunity to launch a weekly, non-stop service between Luxembourg and Buenos Aires," Pierre Wesner, the cargo airline's vice- president, Europe, Middle East and Africa, told Reuters.
He added there was growing demand in Argentina for machinery, equipment and parts from Europe, notably for the automobile industry.
"We will probably launch the Buenos Aires service with one of the two Boeing 747-400Fs we are scheduled to take delivery of in September," Wesner said
Cargolux already operates three weekly 747F frequencies from Luxembourg to Sao Paulo in Brazil and a weekly frequency to Santiago in Chile.

Within the past fortnight, Cargolux had upgraded its weekly Luxembourg-Mexico City freighter service to three weekly frequencies, Wesner added. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
